opening.argument: The speaker describes a Forsage system built around X3 and X4 matrices, where positions fill, produce profit, and reopen. A slide shows payments through the positions and a final payment buying the same slot again. The speaker links joining his team with profits, claims greater benefit at higher levels, and directs interested viewers to contact the person who gave them the link. He then urges viewers to “join without delay.” Together, these are direct invitations to enter a level-based matrix system through repeat slot purchases, with claimed returns tied to filled positions and higher levels. The speaker’s statements that participants do not give money to the company and that this is not a company pay-in, profit-out scheme do not undo that promotion. Nor does the warning against joining blindly: the earning system is still presented as an opportunity and viewers are urged to join.
